text:
anya: Quick Q — bringing my 18mo to conf in SF next week, would babysitter/hotel childcare charges be reimbursable? Also bought an extra seat for the infant. cc @people-ops

mike: Short answer: generally no for personal travel, but exceptions exist when family must accompany employee for work. We need pre-approval for dependent care. Did you get preapproval?

anya: No preapproval — last-minute daycare cancellation so I had to hire a sitter at the hotel for two nights. I have receipts and the sitter invoice.

people-ops: Hi Anya — please submit an expense and request an exception. We need: 1) conference attendance proof (agenda/ticket), 2) short explanation why childcare was required and why no alternative, 3) babysitter invoice/receipt, 4) itinerary showing which days are work vs personal. We review case-by-case. Policy: https://intranet.redwood.com/tx-policy#exceptions :point_down:

jamal: For the extra seat/infant fare — airline baggage/infant rules vary. If personal extension is mixed, we typically only cover the leg used for conference travel. Attach the itinerary and mark the segments that are business.

sophie: Also call out payment method. If hotel/incidental posted to company card that's easier. If you paid cash, include the signed invoice from the sitter. If sitter was arranged through hotel services, the folio sometimes lists "babysitting" — attach that.

anya: Okay I'll file under Travel > Exception with receipts and a note "babysitter emergency - daycare canceled". Should I tag it specific way?

people-ops: Yes tag as "dependent care-exception" in the expense form and put the conference name. Note that if approved, reimbursement may be a taxable benefit in the US — payroll will handle reporting unless you provide documentation that meets dependent care pre-tax rules. We'll DM you the tax details after review.

mike: FYI I helped Jamie with a similar retro exception last month — they approved after receipts + short justification. Happy to help you draft the note if you want. :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks everyone — filing now and will @mike if I need help. Appreciate the quick responses :heart:
